protocol.policy: With one slot left, train which signed load to book at waves six and seven. Learn from freight returns with a purchased reading and with the reading hidden. Estimate purchasing value from the difference those booking policies make on the very same training tape. Buy when estimated gross value exceeds the posted price. Both policies skip outside the one-slot gate.
protocol.markets: Keep eight freight waves, two slots, public observations, the survey and the stronger fee-aware Bayesian planner from Last Slot. Freeze eight new paired openings by a structural draw without scoring. Half of each fresh target has a wave-six market moving against its ending. All policies share latent draws and all prices share a tape. Preserve the original interrupted drop.
protocol.fitting: Train from sampled rewards without latent demand probabilities. Fit the later booking decision before the earlier wait returns. Use separate TRAIN banks for freight decisions, acquisition and candidate selection using only training families. The exact pooling and weighting candidates and selection rule are frozen in fit.mjs. Fit all five seeds before evaluating any public split. Publish seed 13.
protocol.primary: On fresh cold-ending reversals and on fresh hot-ending interrupted drops separately, average fee-adjusted full-shift differences across six equally weighted positive prices. Within each target the lower paired 95% bounds must exceed zero against both the identical learner forced to skip and the independently acting price-aware planner. Free surveys and other endings are secondary.
protocol.retention: Across the seven prices on the original interrupted drop, require positive lower 95% bounds vs the stochastic planner, Booking and Survey, and lower bounds above minus one credit vs each of Last Slot, Tariff, Paid, Rally, Trust, Drift and Turns. Publish the comparison to the current planner as well.
protocol.matched: Secondary test using exactly one remaining slot. The previous Tariff policy plays the first five offers at the posted fee. Clone each eligible public position and underlying tape for the learner, forced skip and planner. Include every eligible case.
protocol.loadChoice: On the new learner's own one-slot openings, compare the eventual booked wave under forced buy and forced skip on identical freight. Report changed loads, better/worse/equal gross pay, fees and net return for actual purchases as well as all eligible branches. Count a different wave with equal pay as a switch. Show each target separately; include no-load as wave zero. Examples follow deterministic manifest order and disclose their selection.
protocol.uncertainty: Use 2,000 paired percentile bootstrap draws resampling entire seeds with all sibling schedules and tariffs. The joint test requires both fresh target checks and original retention. No selection on public outcomes. Other training seeds and the previous Last Slot market archive are sensitivity checks.
